timeline.evidenceText: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.
Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.
Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim.
Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.
To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.
The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

definitions.short: Eber , the name of two patriarchs and four Israelites
definitions.full: H5677. Eber II. עֵ֫בֶר proper name, masculine Eber (perhaps eponym of Hebrews , form inferred from עִבְרִי , compare references there); — 1 'son' of Shelah, and 'grandson' of Arpachshad Gen 10:24 (J) = 1Chr 1:18 ; Gen 11:14-15 , (P); 'father' of Peleg and Joktan 10:25 (J; with especially reference to Joktan 10:26 ff., i.e. to Arabians) = 1Chr 1:19 (compare 1:20 ff.), of Peleg specifically Gen 11:16-17 , (P; with especially reference to Abraham 11:26 f.) compare 1Chr 1:25 (see 1:27 f.); in Gen 10:21 (J) Shem is called כָּלבְּֿנֵיעֵֿבֶר אֲבִי ; ᵐ5 Εβερ . — ׳ע Num 24:24 perhaps (si vera lectio) belongs not here ( = עִבְרִים Hebrews , ᵐ5 Ἐβραίους , so Thes), but below I. עֵבֶר = the (land) beyond (the river), || אַשּׁוּר , so Di Kau. 2 a Gadite chief 1Chr 5:13 , ᵐ5 Ωβηδ , ᵐ5 L Εβερ . 3 Benjamite names: a. 1Chr 8:12 , ᵐ5 Ωβηδ , ᵐ5 L Αβερ . b. 1Chr 8:22 ( עֵבֶר van d. H. Ginsb; עֶבֶד Baer), ᵐ5 Ωβδη , A Ωβηδ , ᵐ5 L Αβερ . 4 a priest Neh 12:20 ᵐ5 L Αβεδ .
